title: Trace morphism from external duality
statement:
Use the global finite-field and finite coefficient datum of [def-fix-six-functor-datum], so that $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, and $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ with $n\ge1$. Let $X,C$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes, $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$, and let $c=(c_1,c_2):C\to X\times_sX$ be an admissible correspondence support in the sense of [def-trf-correspondence]. Let $F=\operatorname{Fix}(c)=C\times_{X\times_sX}X$, $i_F:F\to C$, and $d:F\to X$ be the fixed-square maps of [def-trf-fixed-scheme], and write $p_1,p_2:X\times_sX\to X$ for the projections. Assume the exceptional admissibility at $A$ of $c,p_1,p_2,i_F,d,a_X,a_F$ in the constructible sense of [def-trf-admissibility], where $a_X:X\to s$ and $a_F=a_Xd:F\to s$ are the structure morphisms. There is a canonical morphism
$$
\mathfrak t_{c,K}:R\Gamma(C,\mathcal H_c(K))\longrightarrow R\Gamma(F,\omega_{F,A}),
$$
where $\mathcal H_c(K)=R\mathcal Hom_A(Lc_2^*K,Rc_1^!K)$ is the trace-class source of [def-trf-trace-class-source], $\omega_{F,A}=Ra_F^!A_s$ is the dualizing complex of [def-trf-dualizing-complex], and $R\Gamma$ means ordinary derived global sections of constant-coefficient module sheaves on the small pro-etale site. Namely, put $Z=X\times_sX$, $\Delta=\Delta_X:X\to Z$ (so that $c\,i_F=\Delta d$), $\omega_X=\omega_{X,A}$, $D=D_XK=R\mathcal Hom_A(K,\omega_X)$, and $P=K\boxtimes_A^LD=Lp_1^*K\otimes_A^LLp_2^*D$ as in [def-trf-external-product]. Let $e':L\Delta^*P\to\omega_X$ be the composite of: the restriction isomorphism $L\Delta^*P\xrightarrow{\sim}L\Delta^*Lp_1^*K\otimes_A^LL\Delta^*Lp_2^*D\xrightarrow{\sim}K\otimes_A^LD$, given by the finite-level tensor comparison $\mu_\Delta$ of [lem-pur-derived-pullback-tensor-iso] followed by the inverses of the pullback compositors of [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition] for $p_i\Delta=\operatorname{id}_X$; the signed symmetry $\sigma:K\otimes_A^LD\to D\otimes_A^LK$, induced through [lem-weil-pbc-site-derived-tensor-descent] by $u\otimes v\mapsto(-1)^{pq}v\otimes u$ on homogeneous local sections of degrees $p,q$ of K-flat representatives; and the evaluation $\operatorname{ev}_K:D\otimes_A^LK\to\omega_X$ of [def-trf-dualizing-complex]. Let $e_K:P\to R\Delta_*\omega_X$ be the transpose of $e'$ under the ordinary adjunction $L\Delta^*\dashv R\Delta_*$ of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Then
$$
\mathfrak t_{c,K}=\lambda_{\omega_{F,A}}\circ R\Gamma(C,\varphi),\qquad
\varphi:\mathcal H_c(K)\xrightarrow{\ \xi\ }Rc^!P\xrightarrow{\ Rc^!e_K\ }Rc^!R\Delta_*\omega_X\xrightarrow{\ Bc\ }Ri_{F*}Rd^!\omega_X\xrightarrow{\ Ri_{F*}\gamma\ }Ri_{F*}\omega_{F,A},
$$
where $\xi$ is the external-duality comparison $\mathcal H_c(K)\simeq Rc^!(K\boxtimes_A^LD_XK)$ of [thm-trf-verdier-duality], $Bc$ is the right-adjoint form of fixed-square base change in clause (2) of [thm-trf-fixed-point-base-change], $\gamma:Rd^!\omega_X\xrightarrow{\sim}\omega_{F,A}$ is the isomorphism of [thm-trf-dualizing-complex-composition], and $\lambda:R\Gamma(C,Ri_{F*}(-))\xrightarrow{\sim}R\Gamma(F,-)$ is the inverse of the derived direct-image compositor of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition] for $i_F$ followed by global sections of $C$. The assertion is that every arrow of this composite is defined, each functor being applied inside its stated domain, so that $\mathfrak t_{c,K}$ is a well-defined morphism; this is the external-duality trace map.

proof.text: Put $Z=X\times_sX$, $\Delta=\Delta_X$, $\omega_X=\omega_{X,A}$, and $D=D_XK$. By [def-trf-fixed-scheme], $c i_F=\Delta d$ is the specified Cartesian square, not merely a set-theoretic fixed locus. Using the current ambient-category definitions in [def-trf-dualizing-complex], $\omega_X=Ra_X^!A_s$ and $\omega_F=Ra_F^!A_s$; since $A_s$ is free of rank one in degree zero, the specified restrictions $Ra_X^!:D^b_{ctf}(s,A)\to D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ and $Ra_F^!:D^b_{ctf}(s,A)\to D^b_{ctf}(F,A)$ in [def-trf-admissibility] place both in $D^b_{ctf}$. This preservation comes from the assumed exceptional admissibility, not from the ambient codomain of the dual definition. In particular the input $N=\omega_X$ to fixed-square exceptional base change is permitted.

source.place: Proof, notation and hypotheses of the displayed exceptional base-change composite

proof.text: By clauses (i) and (ii) of [thm-sf-ctf-stability], $D=R\mathcal Hom_A(K,\omega_X)$ belongs to $D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$, since $K$ and $\omega_X$ do, and both its projection pullback and that of $K$, as well as their derived tensor, belong to $D^b_{ctf}(Z,A)$. Form $P=K\boxtimes_A^L D=Lp_1^*K\otimes_A^L Lp_2^*D$ by [def-trf-external-product]. Apply [lem-pur-derived-pullback-tensor-iso] at finite coefficient level to $\Delta$ and these two factors. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition] to $p_i\Delta=\operatorname{id}_X$: its comparison identifies $L\Delta^*Lp_i^*$ with the identity (pullback along the identity has the identity representative). More explicitly, set $\alpha_i=c_{\Delta,p_i}^{-1}:L\Delta^*Lp_i^*\xrightarrow{\sim}L(p_i\Delta)^*=L\operatorname{id}_X^*\cong\operatorname{id}$. The resulting specified isomorphism is $\beta=(\alpha_1(K)\otimes_A^L\alpha_2(D))\circ\mu_{\Delta;Lp_1^*K,Lp_2^*D}:L\Delta^*P\xrightarrow{\sim}K\otimes_A^L D$. All pullbacks here use the identified constant ring sheaves, not completed integral coefficients.

source.place: Proof, first paragraph: the external product pulls back to the tensor on the diagonal; Stacks Tags 07A4 and 0D6D

proof.text: Construct the signed symmetry $\sigma:K\otimes_A^L D\to D\otimes_A^L K$ explicitly. On K-flat representatives $U,V$, send a local homogeneous tensor $u\otimes v$ of bidegree $(p,q)$ to $(-1)^{pq}v\otimes u$. With the differential of [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], the coefficients of $d v\otimes u$ and $v\otimes d u$ in $d\sigma(u\otimes v)$ and $\sigma d(u\otimes v)$ are respectively $(-1)^{pq}$ and $(-1)^{pq+q}$; thus this is a chain map. Its square is the identity and it is natural in both complexes, so [lem-weil-pbc-site-derived-tensor-descent] extends it to the displayed derived isomorphism. In the current statement of [def-trf-dualizing-complex], $D_X$ is the specified contravariant functor $D^b_{ctf}(X,A)^{\mathrm{op}}\to D(X,A)$, and $\operatorname{ev}_K:D\otimes_A^L K\to\omega_X$ is the transpose of $\operatorname{id}_D$ under its specified tensor–internal-Hom adjunction. Apply precisely this definition at $M=K$: the equality $D=R\mathcal Hom_A(K,\omega_X)$ makes $\operatorname{id}_D$ the required right-hand Hom element, so its transpose has exactly the displayed order. Membership of $D$ in $D^b_{ctf}$ was established separately in Step 2, not asserted by this definition. Set $e'=\operatorname{ev}_K\circ\sigma\circ\beta:L\Delta^*P\to\omega_X$. This retains the Koszul sign in the symmetry.

source.place: Proof, first paragraph: evaluation preceded by the tensor symmetry

proof.text: The ordinary derived adjunction in [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], applied to $\Delta$ with coefficient ring $A$, transposes $e'$ to $e_K:P\to R\Delta_*\omega_X$. Explicitly $e_K=R\Delta_*(e')\circ\eta_{\Delta,P}$, where $\eta_\Delta$ is the unit of $L\Delta^*\dashv R\Delta_*$. This uses the ordinary unbounded module adjunction, and requires no ambient exceptional adjoint for $\Delta$.

source.place: Proof, first paragraph: the adjoint evaluation kernel; Stacks Tag 07A6

proof.text: By [def-trf-trace-class-source] the source object is $\mathcal H_c(K)=R\mathcal Hom_A(Lc_2^*K,Rc_1^!K)$. The comparison stated in [thm-trf-verdier-duality], with the same factor order $P=K\boxtimes_A^L D_XK$, supplies $\xi:\mathcal H_c(K)\xrightarrow{\sim}Rc^!P$. Its hypotheses are exactly $K\in D^b_{ctf}$, admissibility of the correspondence, and exceptional admissibility of $c,p_1,p_2$, all in the statement. Clause (iii) of [thm-sf-ctf-stability], applied to the diagonal morphism of the separated finite-type scheme $X$, places $R\Delta_*\omega_X$ in $D^b_{ctf}(Z,A)$. Step 2 has placed $P$ there as well, so $Rc^!$ is defined on both ends of $e_K$. Compose with $Rc^!e_K$ to obtain $\mathcal H_c(K)\to Rc^!R\Delta_*\omega_X$.

source.place: Proof, second paragraph: first two arrows of the displayed composite

proof.text:
Apply the right-adjoint form in clause (2) of [thm-trf-fixed-point-base-change] to $N=\omega_X$, which is in its finite-Tor domain by Step 1. It gives $Bc:Rc^!R\Delta_*\omega_X\xrightarrow{\sim}Ri_{F*}Rd^!\omega_X$. Since $a_F=a_Xd$ and the displayed structure maps are exceptionally admissible, [thm-trf-dualizing-complex-composition] supplies $\gamma:Rd^!\omega_X\xrightarrow{\sim}\omega_F$. Therefore
$$\varphi=Ri_{F*}(\gamma)\circ Bc\circ Rc^!e_K\circ\xi:\mathcal H_c(K)\longrightarrow Ri_{F*}\omega_F.$$
No assertion that an arbitrary mate of an isomorphism is invertible is needed: the cited fixed-square theorem states this particular right-adjoint comparison as an isomorphism.

source.place: Proof, second paragraph: last two arrows of the displayed composite

proof.text:
Let $g$ be the global-sections morphism from the ringed topos $(\operatorname{Sh}(C_{\mathrm{proet}}),A_C)$ to the one-point ringed topos with ring $A$, and let $f$ be the ringed-topos morphism induced by $i_F$. The composite $g f$ is the global-sections morphism for $F$: on a module sheaf $M$, $\Gamma(C,i_{F*}M)=\Gamma(F,M)$, since $F\times_C C=F$. The ordinary unbounded comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition] consequently gives $\lambda:R\Gamma(C,Ri_{F*}(-))\xrightarrow{\sim}R\Gamma(F,-)$ (the inverse of its stated compositor). Define
$$\mathfrak t_{c,K}=\lambda_{\omega_F}\circ R\Gamma(C,\varphi).$$
This has exactly the required source and target. Equivalently the adjunction of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] for $i_F$ sends $\varphi$ to $\theta_{c,K}=\varepsilon_{i_F,\omega_F}\circ Li_F^*\varphi:Li_F^*\mathcal H_c(K)\to\omega_F$. Every component has been constructed under the stated finite-coefficient hypotheses, so no additional properness assumption on $c$ or $F$ is used.

source.place: Proof, final paragraph: taking derived global sections, and the equivalent adjoint along i_F; Stacks Tags 0D6E and 07A6

proof_origin.place: Entire proof, with the diagonal restriction, signed symmetry, adjunction and global-sections compositor made explicit; underlying formal tools are Stacks Tags 07A4, 0D6D, 07A6, 0D6E

Step 2: thm-sf-ctf-stability (i)-(ii) give D and P in D^b_ctf without site-perfectness; mu_Delta for arbitrary ambient M,N; inverse compositors for p_i Delta=id. Step 3: I recomputed the Koszul coefficients (-1)^{pq} and (-1)^{pq+q}; ev_K is the transpose of id_D. Step 4: the ordinary adjunction is in the statement of def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations. Step 5: the comparison in thm-trf-verdier-duality keeps the order K, then D_XK; ctf-stability (iii) covers RDelta_*omega_X. Step 6: the forward right-adjoint form in clause (2) of fixed-point base change, then Rd^!omega_X = omega_F. Step 7: the ringed-topoi compositor with the punctual topos gives global sections on F.
